goal: Treat Markdown Files Like Code: Section-level AST nodes (@Doc/path.md#slug), symbol-gated backtick reference edges, and quarantined fenced-code-block identifier extraction - additive to the shipped docs-to-graph machinery, zero behavior change on the non-doc graph.
design_locks: DL-1 SECTION IDS: section node id = '@Doc/<path>#<slug>' where slug is the GitHub-style heading slug (lowercase, spaces->hyphens, punctuation stripped); duplicate slugs in one file disambiguate '-2','-3' in document order. Headings parsed at ALL levels (#..######); depth recorded in metadata. Whole-file '@Doc/<path>' node is RETAINED as the container - section nodes are additive children.

DL-2 CONTAINMENT: new edge kind 'contains' (@Doc/file -> @Doc/file#section, document order preserved in evidence). ANY new edge kind MUST be taught to BOTH adjacency indexes in the same task: src/query/canonical-graph.ts AND src/cli/mcp/graph-tools.ts (the dual-index trap from the API-surface WO).

DL-3 REFERENCE GATE: backtick tokens mint a 'references' edge (@Doc/file#section -> element/file node) ONLY when the token resolves in the scan's symbol table. Exact-name match; ambiguous (>1 candidate element) = disclosed skip counted in DocIngestResult-style skip ledger, NEVER a guessed edge. Non-resolving backticks (paths, flags, kebab-slugs) are silent non-facts. Evidence carries section id + match name.

DL-4 SNIPPET QUARANTINE: fenced code blocks NEVER enter the global symbol table (no scanner.ts symbol registration - supersedes the stub's original wording per discovery REC-001). Instead a lightweight identifier extractor (ts/js fences only, v1) feeds the SAME DL-3 membership gate to mint 'references' edges with a distinct evidence kind ('doc-code-block'). Call resolution, resolution-rate metrics, rename_preview/apply, and clone detection remain untouched by doc content.

DL-5 INCREMENTAL PARITY BY CONSTRUCTION: sections/references ride the existing collectDocsPhase lane - repo-global, re-collected fresh in BOTH run() and runIncremental(), never per-file incremental facts. No new keying seams.

DL-6 NO-REGRESS INSTRUMENT: frozen-tree A/B (old dist vs new dist over one immutable tree copy, no --source-headers) with comparison FILTERED to the non-'@Doc' id universe -> MUST be byte-identical sha256. Pre-existing @Doc whole-file nodes and 'documents' edges MUST also be id-identical (feature is strictly additive). Live-repo before/after fingerprints are NOT the instrument (self-hosting id-shift, ADJ-1 precedent).

DL-7 DETERMINISM (AC-08): heading walk is document-order over the raw text; slug disambiguation, identifier extraction, and edge order are all deterministic given identical bytes. No clock, no randomness.

DL-8 SCOPE v1: the three existing doc-ingest lanes ONLY (resource sheets, foundation docs, opted-in reports). docs/*.md, README.md, root markdown stay OUT until the grain proves out (discovery REC-006; operator may widen later).
